summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-11-23 ~ 2026-11-25）

- ⚡ KVM x86 按 vCPU 运行状态动态切换 mediated PMU 上下文，减少 PMU 状态保存恢复开销（[Virtualization](#subsystem-Virtualization)）
- 🔥 exec 移除 UAPI 的 AT_VECTOR_SIZE_ARCH，统一各架构 auxvec 定义（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ MGLRU 引入频率引导页晋升，基准显示内存占用与回收延迟同步下降（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）
- ✨ Rust 驱动新增运行时 PM 绑定与 helper，可在 Rust 侧直接使用设备电源管理（[Drivers](#subsystem-Drivers)）
- ⚡ xsk 改为按设备缓冲布局接收，削减 XDP 收包路径的元数据转换与拷贝（[Networking](#subsystem-Networking)）
- ⚡ percpu_counter 改用 rwlock 支持并发求和，缓解读侧争用、提升计数读取扩展性（[Core Kernel](#subsystem-Core%20Kernel)）

## Filesystem & Storage
- 为 Rockchip RK3576 增加从 OTP CPU ID 派生 MAC 地址的 nvmem 布局，arm64 设备树即可免烧写 MAC [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-rk3576-otp-cpuid-mac-v3-0-40c756dcf36f@flipper.net/)
- `perf` `bugfix` ext4 7.4-rc5 更新集：分配器、位图、block_validity 及 kunit 测试重构，改善块组元数据校验路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/awW86EI5fYafQx-o@mit.edu/)
- UFS core 新增 debugfs 节点导出 PA TFS/FEC 错误计数，便于定位链路可靠性问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124012951.3143833-1-powenkao@google.com/)
- exfat 新增 EXFAT_IOC_COMBINE，可把一个文件的簇区间追加到另一文件，便于免拷贝合并 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124142807.773299-1-shaopei_1012@163.com/)
- `other` UFS RPMB 失败时返回 -EIO 而非 SCSI result，统一块层与用户态错误码语义 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-b4-ufs-3-rpmb-errno-v1-1-65b54643ca21@samsung.com/)
- `perf` `other` ksmbd 通过 splice 将 READ 负载经 TCP 零拷贝发送，减少大文件读取的内存拷贝开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124132554.1185817-1-huiwen.he@linux.dev/)
- 块设备可作为 NVMEM provider，分区表解析后向 nvmem 框架导出设备数据，供网卡等消费 MAC [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-block-as-nvmem-v13-0-96ffe1f59332@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- ext4 拒绝不可能的块组空闲簇计数，配合 jbd2 恢复期元数据校验钩子阻止损坏镜像挂载 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124033900.76700-1-zhaogongyi@bytedance.com/)
- ocfs2 直接 I/O 从 buffer_head 迁移到 iomap，统一大文件直写路径并降低复杂度 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124152623.7838-1-heming.zhao@suse.com/)
- jbd2 新增日志恢复期元数据校验钩子，允许文件系统在重放前拒绝非法块计数 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124033900.76700-2-zhaogongyi@bytedance.com/)
- 另有 36 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124195315.105369-1-alex@amutable.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124115404.2937581-1-joseph.qi@linux.alibaba.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-dhchap-keyring-v4-v6-0-5082a49715ab@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-delegts-fixes-v3-0-6fe4ba705aef@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123141235.2477526-1-graypanda.inzag@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123193000.3419445-1-bmarzins@redhat.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-nfs-space-limit-v3-1-993945e1a526@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124033357.830767-1-nilayvaish@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124025932.2360848-1-zhanxusheng1024@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123182354.2091665-1-mc@raidlab.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124195430.105522-1-alex@amutable.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124174726.2223430-1-sashal@kernel.org/) 等 36 项

## Virtualization
- `perf` `bugfix` 按 vCPU 运行状态动态切换 mediated PMU 上下文，减少 PMU 状态保存恢复开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124002303.1785363-1-yosry@kernel.org/)
- 为 KVM x86 客户机开放 APX 寄存器与指令支持，扩展新硬件特性可用性。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123173732.1072124-1-chang.seok.bae@intel.com/)
- 在 MMIO stale data VERW 流程中保留 FB_CLEAR，避免误清缓解位影响后续清理。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124180613.1693632-1-amirmohammad.eftekhar@cispa.de/)
- `bugfix` 修复 nVMX 嵌套 APICv 模拟，改善 Windows 客户机中断投递。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123175512.80438-1-mlevitsk@redhat.com/)
- `other` 对使用私有内存的 VM 禁用 SMM 进入，避免 SMM 与私有内存模型冲突。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124032748.1221979-1-gdool88@gmail.com/)
- `perf` 在 VFIO PCI 核心提供 BAR 对齐，支持大页映射并降低 VM 内存映射开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124073048.268988-1-guanghuifeng@linux.alibaba.com/)
- `other` 将多处简单 mmap 钩子迁到 mmap_prepare，统一 VMA 准备流程。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-late-2026-mmap_prepare-v2-0-0b0d99d655f9@kernel.org/)
- 为 virtio/vhost vsock 增加数据报传输，扩展无连接通信语义。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-vsock-dgram-support-v4-0-3607484e85e8@redhat.com/)
- 用 vCPU dirty ring 限制 KVM_PRE_FAULT_MEMORY 范围，避免预故障越界。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123113435.1170711-1-fuad.tabba@linux.dev/)
- 支持客户机 PAGE_SIZE 小于 hypervisor granule 的 pKVM 保护 VM，扩展 arm64 部署兼容性。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124164446.2371939-1-vdonnefort@google.com/)
- 另有 1 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123143318.73514-1-fangxy@xiaopeng.com/)

## Architecture
- `perf` perf：accel/rocket 使能 RK3576 NPU/RKNN，新增 UAPI/驱动/DTS。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795478392.git.gahing@gahingwoo.com/)
- feature：PCI/ACPI 支持 Microsoft DmaProperty，联动 IOMMU 与 PCI 枚举。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123235845.564027-1-dmaluka@chromium.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` perf：x86/kstack_erase 加速栈污染，并修复 startup 构建问题。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123174703.133167-1-usama.arif@linux.dev/)
- `perf` perf：arm64 dts allwinner 增加 A733/Cubie A7S 支持。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-a733-cubie-a7s-dt-v5-0@gmail.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` perf：perf/x86/amd/ibs 阻止 PERF_SAMPLE_WEIGHT_STRUCT 泄露栈内容。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123162315.1142701-1-usama.arif@linux.dev/)
- feature：KVM arm64 CCA 准备 Realm 内存管理，扩展 RMI/页表路径。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123104233.95710-1-steven.price@arm.com/)
- feature：exec 移除 UAPI 的 AT_VECTOR_SIZE_ARCH，统一各架构 auxvec 定义。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-at-vector-size-arch-v3-0-d342dae9e843@linutronix.de/)
- feature：arm64 dts exynos 增加 Exynos7885 USB 支持。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123092244.1792040-1-virag.david003@gmail.com/)
- feature：vdso 构建期拒绝绝对重定位，防止生成不可用 vDSO。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-vdso-absolute-reloc-v6-0-161e218dd217@linutronix.de/)
- feature：nvmem 增加 STM32 TAMP nvram 驱动与 DT 支持。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-upstream_nvram_reworked-v6-0-ea0cfccc20b0@foss.st.com/)
- 另有 116 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124124207.199382-1-francesco@dolcini.it/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124023558.4088635-1-eleanor.lin@realtek.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-qcom-bcl-hwmon-v5-0-747d5383d538@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-b4-pdm_clk_gp_mnd_v2-v3-0-98db26a87500@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/179543878283.1348.10115969159184460350@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123103106.953938-1-pbonzini@redhat.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-device-trust-core-v4-0-037eb0d17b1f@nvidia.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-dmaengine-support-wider-dma-masks-v7-0-5d57df2c3ebd@analog.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-ups_mp25_clk_syscfg-v4-0-894d95dffec4@foss.st.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-rk3576-otp-cpuid-mac-v4-0-d403b8a25113@flipper.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795517711.git.yadu.mg@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-mahua_iris_enable-v2-0-b1a16b16afca@oss.qualcomm.com/) 等 116 项

## Observability
- `perf` udmabuf 巨页缓冲 mmap 改走 PFNMAP 路径，避免逐页处理，显著提速 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-feat-udmabuf-huge-pfnmap-v2-0-3254f801fc36@linux.dev/)
- `perf` `other` script 引入符号懒加载，大幅降低大符号表内存占用并加快启动 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-perf-symbol-memory-send-v9-0-56f298185eae@uber.com/)
- `perf` 符号表改为有序数组存储，缩小内存占用并加速符号查找 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124032902.3859564-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` 支持命名空间与 chroot 下的路径解析，修复容器内符号与调试信息定位 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123232025.1406560-1-namhyung@kernel.org/)
- `perf` 为 annotate/bench/config 等此前无覆盖的 perf 子命令补充 shell 测试 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124184604.24983-1-acme@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 新增 perf 覆盖率测试框架，并修复其暴露的 annotate 等路径缺陷 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123220024.14891-1-acme@kernel.org/)
- `perf` KVM selftests 增加 steal-time 脏页日志与 RISC-V STA 状态切换测试 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124033328.612894-1-shanbeeyoo@gmail.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` v3：旧版 Clang 缺少 __guarded_by 导致构建失败，改为空桩定义 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-james-perf-late-parse-attr-v3-1-f9e906dd9da5@linaro.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` turbostat 修正计数器格式与 CPU 选择文档，避免输出被误读 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124032723.157254-1-qinyuntan@linux.alibaba.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 仅在 Clang 23 及以上启用上下文分析，避免旧编译器解析失败 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-james-perf-late-parse-attr-v1-1-cfebcd81a962@linaro.org/)
- 另有 19 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-james-perf-event_refresh-v1-1-571efa5395ab@linaro.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124152845.2233401-1-vdonnefort@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123152743.19629-1-leon.hwang@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124150753.115914-1-muralikrishna2444b@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124020814.1679635-1-jrhilke@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123150127.635412-1-georgeezra017@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-i6500-cm3-pmu-v4-0-5a9f5351688f@mobileye.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123230410.3206378-1-wfelipe@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/179547260053.326766.11540305553612301074.stgit@devnote2/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124181038.2362595-1-sashal@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-kunit-v2-v2-0-e1adbcad6b48@student.oaklandcc.edu/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123201406.479904-1-maxime.chevallier@bootlin.com/) 等 19 项

## Drivers
- bcm2835 DMA 支持 BCM2711/2712 40 位寻址，联动 RPi5 的 DTS、MMC、SPI、HDMI [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123145728.29082-1-andrea.porta@suse.com/)
- IIO 核心通过 regmap 提供 debugfs 寄存器访问，统一多款传感器驱动实现 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124065016.185124-1-zoone.rupert@gmail.com/)
- Rust 运行时 PM 支持，新增设备 PM 绑定与 helper，供 Rust 驱动使用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124113555.2480381-1-beata.michalska@arm.com/)
- 新增 drm_fb_dma_get_gem_clipped_addr 辅助并改造 imx/sun4i，简化裁剪地址计算 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124074041.115251-1-wenst@chromium.org/)
- qcom x1e80100 允许用户空间覆盖 WSA 声道映射，PCM 核心新增对应接口 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-b4-sound-qcom-x1e80100-allow-ucm-channel-map-v4-0-1197ac8eacd2@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `other` SoundWire 允许设备在 remove 阶段继续通信，便于 SOF Intel 卸载时序 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124161001.702882-1-ckeepax@opensource.cirrus.com/)
- `bugfix` HID 核心与多驱动批量修复，含 Apple/ASUS/Logitech 设备兼容问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/019pr649-8s0o-np46-4p81-2805n9n9q54q@xreary.bet/)
- `bugfix` gpiolib 修复字符设备仍持有线路时的芯片移除路径，避免 UAF [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-gpiolib-chip-removal-v8-0-aambrozewicz@nvidia.com/)
- `other` x86 事件/hwmon/平台驱动注释中的 rdmsr/wrmsr 改为新名称 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124064108.2440277-1-jgross@suse.com/)
- `other` cxl 在 EINJ 初始化时创建 debugfs 节点，理顺 CXL 注入时序 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/179550361711.991197.13876815308672111616@kylinos.cn/)
- 另有 101 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-topic-sm8x50-iio-max34417-adc-v7-0-d8f87edc5086@linaro.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124094502.557175-1-andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123225239.1653134-1-zhenwenliang@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123125127.4114196-1-takano32@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-rust-drm-gem-shmem-imported-sgt-v2-0-000f7a9ccb8d@jannau.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795505160.git.hns@goldelico.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-topic-sm8650-el2-v2-0-174e159f0f69@linaro.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124085058.128173-1.l.scorcia@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-lut-v1-0-5556c89a2ebd@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124173658.31030-1-andrea.porta@suse.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124173900.31266-1-andrea.porta@suse.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124113723.3055530-1-wangxiaolei01@kaihong.com/) 等 100 项

## Networking
- arm64 monaco-arduino-monza 增加 LGA WiFi/BT 模块的 DT 节点与 PCIe M.2 连接器描述，hci_qca 适配上电时序 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-monza-wireless-v9-0-450d7d764aea@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 9p 限制零拷贝错误回复大小，避免 virtio 环溢出与性能退化 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123204257.3055515-1-lian@is.s.u-tokyo.ac.jp/)
- `perf` `other` xsk 改为按设备缓冲布局接收，减少 XDP 收包路径的元数据转换与拷贝，bnxt/mlx5/fbnic 先行适配 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124112707.118678-1-bjorn@kernel.org/)
- genetlink 拒绝加入没有 family 所有的多播组，收紧 netlink 权限边界 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123155503.2497063-1-anilkaushikwireless@gmail.com/)
- stmmac XGMAC 支持最多 16 个 MTL/DMA 队列 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124000415.4067701-1-sagar.cheluvegowda@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- adin1110 增加 OPEN Alliance TC6 支持 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123115743.29523-1-iustin.stolniceanu@analog.com/)
- `bugfix` x25 在释放邻居前关闭 T20 定时器，避免定时器 UAF [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124093922.39573-1-f3lix.dev@gmx.de/)
- GRE/IPIP/SIT 等 IP 隧道启用 BIG TCP，支持更大 GSO 报文以减少分片 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124013124.3693-1-yanhaishuang@cmss.chinamobile.com/)
